_meta.description: Card scoring knowledge base. Each entry defines scoring metadata for a single card used by hand_analyst and turn_planner.

fields.card_id: Unique identifier (e.g. set code + number, e.g. 'SVI-001')
fields.energy_cost: Total energy required to use primary attack (0 if Trainer/Energy)
fields.damage_output: Base damage of primary attack (0 if non-attacking)
fields.utility_score: 0–10 score for non-damage value (draw, search, disruption, etc.)
fields.combo_tags: List of tag strings that link synergistic cards (e.g. ['bench-snipe', 'attach-from-discard'])
fields.deck_frequency: 0.0–1.0 — how often this card appears across top-tier decks (meta presence)
fields.ev_score: Computed expected-value score; updated by eval_agent after each game cycle
